answer: The reed stacks stand by the cottage, bundles bound and waiting. Proof of thatcher via reed roof tally — a roof the thatcher lays only after 23 roofs hold their thatch without one leaking at the ridge, each laid by the thatcher himself. lotus lays the first course thick and fixes it with spars. tundra combs the reed straight and dresses the edge. onyx caps the ridge with straw and binds it down. Twenty-three roofs must hold their thatch without one leaking at the ridge, and the next still leaks where the reed ran thin.
